scenes.look: sky gradient (196,208,224)->(236,236,228); striped green ground below y=0; ball shaded sphere (albedo = protocol colour, light from upper-left, specular); hard-edged ground shadow (x2 0.70); no antialiasing

render.physics: free fall + vertical bounce with restitution 0.6, constant vx, no friction; identical to v1.0 until first impact (5.25-7.95 s)

input.note: unchanged from v1.0: source indices 0,4,...,60 only; frames 61..270 never enter the encoder

model.layer: final post-LayerNorm encoder tokens, hierarchical output disabled
model.pooling: mean over 4608 tokens, no L2 norm

readers.split: leave one scene (start position) out; 20 train / 4 test
readers.scaling: train-only mean + single scalar RMS scale; degenerate if s_f <= 1e-12
readers.solver: dual: W = A^T (A A^T + n*lambda*I)^-1 (Y - Ybar); linear solve, no explicit inverse

decision.primary: E_full, E_proj < min(E_CV, E_prior) and rho <= 1.10
